name: SketchAI 333-class MobileNetV2 model
input_format: float32, grayscale, app preprocessing currently white ink on black with 0..1 range
classes_file: classes.txt; order derived from attached class_indices.json indices 0..332
conversion: inference graph preserves trained layers/weights and removes training-only RandomTranslation/RandomRotation/RandomZoom layers; source-vs-converted inference equality checked in Python
notes: The branch archive lacks training-data provenance, preprocessing details, and evaluation metrics. The model is present for explicit evaluation only; its output-label map is unverified, so the verified 345-class model remains the default.

smoke_test.kind: hand-drawn functional smoke test, not a held-out validation split

comparison.protocol: Same hand-drawn stroke inputs, rasterizer, application prediction/suggestion path, and intended labels; each model used its configured preprocessing.
comparison.interpretation: 345-class model led by 3 examples at top-1 and 3 at top-10; 333-class model led by 1 at top-3; top-5 tied. Tiny hand-drawn sample only. Interpretation also depends on the unverified 333-class label map and provisional input normalization.

caveats: 333-class training-data overlap with the test set cannot be ruled out
333-class input normalization is undocumented and app preprocessing is provisional
test set samples 40 of 333 shared categories
